Review: Three-Week Family Journey Across India
I thoroughly enjoyed my three-week trip to India with my daughter and son in March 2026. Overall, the experience met the expectations and promises set by the organizer, Nazir (Muzu) Muzamil.
Accommodations
The hotels were generally well-located, with some featuring exceptional spots, particularly in Jaisalmer. The rooms were spacious; however, cleanliness could be improved. We noticed stained linens and towels on occasion, and floors were not always spotless. Wi-Fi connectivity was often unstable and hit-or-miss. While the hotel staff was dedicated and the food quality was consistently very good, international guests might require a brief orientation on how to operate the local electrical switches.
Transportation
• Air Travel: Perfectly organized and well-planned.
• Road Travel: Our driver, Sala (Salu) Uddin, was wonderful—always cheerful, friendly, and great company. His driving was calm, responsible, and safe. We truly appreciated his patience and his helpful recommendations. One area for improvement would be the communication between the organizer and the driver, as there were a few mornings when the driver did not yet know our destination for the evening. Additionally, a couple of the driving legs felt slightly too long.
Dining
The lunch spots suggested by our driver along the route were well-situated and served excellent food.
Itinerary & Sightseeing
The circuit covers the major must-see sites effectively.
• Highlights: Rajasthan is an absolute must for its history, architecture, and vibrant culture. Varanasi is essential for its unique religious and sacred character. In the South, Cochin and Kovalam are excellent for relaxation and discovering the region's specific heritage.
• Disappointments: The backwater cruise in Alleppey was underwhelming. There was very little to see or do, and in my opinion, it was not worth the detour.
Service & Management
Muzu responded quickly and appropriately to an unexpected situation when a member of our group fell ill. However, general communication with the organizer was sometimes slow or felt like it was happening at the last minute.
Overall: A very positive experience with some minor logistical adjustments suggested for the future.
